title: Settings
summary: The user's OpenRouter API key, and the model the agent runs on.
description: The agent has a section of its own in the app's settings, named after its profession.

requirements.text: The user enters an OpenRouter API key in the agent's settings.

A key can be checked with OpenRouter, either automatically when it is saved or by the user with a button, whichever fits the product best, and the settings say whether it was accepted and, if not, why.

history.text: A key is checked with OpenRouter when it is saved, and the settings say whether it was accepted and, if not, why.
history.reason: A key can be checked automatically or by hand with a check button, whichever fits best.

requirements.text: The settings list the models OpenRouter offers, the complete list as OpenRouter provides it, and the user chooses one.
Each model in the list shows its name, its provider and its price per million input and output tokens.

history.text: Each model in the list shows its name, its provider, how much context it takes and its price per million input and output tokens.
history.reason: How much context a model takes is left out of the list.

requirements.text: The list of models can be searched by name and provider.
When the list of models can't be fetched, the settings say why and keep the chosen model.
